name: Curved Plane Reconstruction
definition: A subcategory of multiplanar reconstructions that displays all voxels contained in a user-selectable curved surface as a single bidimensional image, allowing the user to follow winding structures in their entirety along their natural path.
summary: Curved Plane Reconstruction extracts a 2D cross-section along a user-defined curved path, unrolling winding structures into a straightened view unlike standard orthogonal MPR.
